ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java fun isValidRow(row) = (trim(row.sale_id default "") != "") and (trim(row.sale_date default "") matches /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}.*/) and (trim(row.country_code default "") matches /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/) and (trim(row.currency default "") matches /^[A-Za-z]{3}$/) and (trim(row.amount_local default "") matches /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/) and ((trim(row.amount_local default "0") as Number default 0) > 0) --- (payload default []) filter isValidRow($) map ($ ++ { country_code: upper(trim($.country_code)), currency: upper(trim($.currency)), amount_local: trim($.amount_local), sale_date: trim($.sale_date) })

http:request.doc:name: GET FX rate

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 import round2, toEur, rateFor from modules::Fx output application/json
var enriched = (vars.rows default []) map (row) -> { country_code: row.country_code, country_name: (vars.countryLookup[row.country_code].name) default row.country_code, region: (vars.countryLookup[row.country_code].region) default "UNKNOWN", currency: row.currency, fx_rate: rateFor(row.currency, vars.fxRates), amount_eur: toEur(row.amount_local as Number, rateFor(row.currency, vars.fxRates)), sale_date: row.sale_date[0 to 9] as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} } var dates = enriched map $.sale_date --- { generated_at: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}, period_start: if (isEmpty(dates)) null else min(dates) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, period_end: if (isEmpty(dates)) null else max(dates) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, total_sales_count: sizeOf(enriched), total_amount_eur: round2(sum (enriched map $.amount_eur)), by_country: (enriched groupBy $.country_code) pluck ((rows, code) -> { country_code: code, country_name: rows[0].country_name, region: rows[0].region, sales_count: sizeOf(rows), amount_eur: round2(sum(rows map $.amount_eur)) }), by_currency: (enriched groupBy $.currency) pluck ((rows, cur) -> { currency: cur, sales_count: sizeOf(rows), amount_eur: round2(sum (rows map $.amount_eur)), fx_rate: rows[0].fx_rate }) }

logger.doc:name: Log summary
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Digest built: rows_read=" ++ (vars.rowsRead default 0) ++ " valid=" ++ sizeOf(vars.rows default []) ++ " invalid=" ++ ((vars.rowsRead default 0) - sizeOf(vars.rows default []))]

logger.doc:name: Log run finished
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Sales digest run finished: sent total_sales_count=" ++ (vars.digest.total_sales_count default 0) ++ " total_amount_eur=" ++ (vars.digest.total_amount_eur default 0)]

logger.doc:name: Log error context
logger.message: #["Sales digest run failed: type=" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN") ++ " reason=" ++ (error.description default "n/a")]

logger.doc:name: Log cache miss
logger.message: Country cache miss - loading reference from REST Countries

set-variable.doc:name: Remaining offsets
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var pages = ceil((payload.data.meta.total default 0) / 100.0) --- if (pages > 1) ((1 to (pages - 1)) map ($ * 100)) else []]

set-variable.doc:name: Index by alpha_2
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.countries default []) filter (($.codes.alpha_2 default '') != '') reduce (c, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (c.codes.alpha_2): { name: c.names.common, region: c.region } }]
